verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's background automation is limited to built-in monitoring triggers. Uptime monitors ping your site on a schedule or accept scheduled heartbeat requests, and they alert via email or webhook. Project alert rules automatically notify teams or webhook URLs when errors arrive. These are fixed alerting automations, not user-defined autonomous workflows or agents, and the MCP server only exposes data to external AI tools. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow rules, autonomous agent or AI-driven actions (e.g., auto-triage or auto-resolve), scheduled jobs beyond uptime checks, independent corroboration.
